[Hi there!]{.custom-subtitle}

I'm a researcher and [science facilitator](https://doi.org/10.1057/s41599-022-01217-1) with expertise in marine ecology, long-term research, and collaborating across disciplines and career levels.

My PhD work focused on how long-term studies can accelerate discovery in the deep ocean while also training the next generation of scientists. Read more about my [research interests](https://allisonpayne.github.io/research.html), or explore my [projects](https://allisonpayne.github.io/projects.html).

I work as the Science Facilitation Coordinator for the National Center for Ecological Analysis and Synthesis. I am also available for hire as an independent science facilitator for working groups, organizations, or research teams looking to get the most out of their collaborative projects. Please contact me if you are interested in this service.
